MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub android version [options]

Show or change apps/android/version.properties (every change also increments
versionCode)

Options:
  --bump <part>  patch, minor or major (versionCode += 1)
  --set <x.y.z>  Set versionName (versionCode += 1)
  --code <n>     Set versionCode explicitly (must increase)
  --json         Print { versionName, versionCode } as JSON
  -h, --help     display help for command
